data.name: Dwingle : B.O.T
data.detailed_description:
Start at the dawn of the day, in a closed room. Build Bot from scratch, your only companion for the entire game.
Achieve tasks and games, resolve enigmas like in an escape room and reach the goal to move on to another day.
Each day has a different objective and achievements to realize, until the end of this first episode.

The experience will be different for each player, as Bot’s mood changes and adapts depending on how you interact. A lot can happen, and each experience is unique!

--

We are an independent studio, we need you and your feedback to help us resolve some possible bugs.
We hope you're going to have fun and enjoy playing Dwingle. Now let's work on the next episodes.

Thank you!

data.short_description: In this narrative puzzle game, interact with your environment behind closed doors, along with Botanic (Bot) the robot. Build a connection and evolve with him, interact and play with your surroundings...

+ Few optional achievements

- Require holding grip buttons - not comfortable with the current Vive controllers
- Very short
- Minor bugs - sometimes physics go crazy, performance issues when watching cartoon (even with GTX 1080), [spoiler]I bought a fuse in advance, but when I needed it, it disappeared and I had to find the one I was supposed to find anyway[/spoiler]

• I'm quite disappointed it turned into a horror game. Building and teaching your own robot would be much nicer and may last longer. This way, I don't know who is its target audience - the first half for kids, the second one for those who like escape room horrors?
